title: What Is a Push Notification? A Business Guide

facts.fact: The page states that a push notification costs nothing per send.
facts.quote: It costs nothing per send, works without an open browser, and requires explicit opt-in permission

facts.fact: The page states that a push notification's body text typically has 40–100 characters before it truncates on most devices.
facts.quote: typically 40–100 characters before it truncates on most devices

facts.fact: The vendor's comparison table lists the cost per send for in-app messages as $0, with no opt-in required.
facts.quote: | In-app message | $0  | No  | N/A (user must already be inside the app) |

facts.fact: The vendor's comparison table lists the cost per SMS as roughly $0.01–$0.05 per message.
The vendor's comparison table cites a third-party (Insider, 2023) typical push notification open rate of about 7–10%.
The vendor's comparison table cites a third-party (Mailchimp, 2024) typical email open rate of about 20–25%.
The vendor's comparison table cites a third-party (Klaviyo, 2024) typical SMS open rate of about 90% or more.
The page cites Airship's 2023 Push Notification Benchmark Report as showing that opt-out rates spike when promotional push frequency exceeds 2–3 messages per week for most retail categories.
facts.quote: opt-out rates spike when promotional frequency exceeds 2–3 messages per week for most retail categories

facts.fact: The page claims that most apps spend their single push permission request in the first four seconds of the first session.
facts.quote: Most apps spend it in the first four seconds of the first session

facts.fact: The page claims that a poor push permission decision can cut a business's reachable audience in half, permanently.
facts.quote: That one bad decision can cut your reachable audience in half — permanently.

facts.fact: The page states that the article was last updated on September 1, 2026.
